name: Lontium Semiconductor Corporation
summary: Lontium Semiconductor Corporation develops and markets of interface chips, video bridges, and processors and display drivers in China and internationally. The company offers data/video transmission, including transmitter and receiver, repeater and re-driver, and bridge, as well as switch, splitter, and matrix; scaling and processing products; small and medium, and large size display driver. It serves automotive, display and accessories, micro display, and industry and communication sectors. Lontium Semiconductor Corporation was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Hefei, China.
